messages.content: Hi tal, I'm a friend

yo! "a friend" isn't gonna cut it here...

i'm tal, your talent agent. think of me as your inside person in the bangalore tech scene.

i find people actual jobs at companies that pay real money. not advice, not gyaan - actual interviews.

but first, i need to know who you are.

what's your full name?
Prakash Bendapudi

prakash bendapudi... that's a solid name. sounds like someone who gets things done.

where you working these days?
I am a Staff Engineer with Innovaccer

staff engineer at innovaccer... building healthcare tech that's actually making a dent in the system. that's some serious impact work.

found you on linkedin - prakash bendapudi, staff engineer at innovaccer. this you? https://in.linkedin.com/in/prakash-bendapudi
That’s right

nice! staff engineer at innovaccer... you're building the backend that keeps healthcare data flowing properly. that's no joke - healthcare tech where bugs can literally affect patient care. 

what made you get into healthcare tech? most engineers run away from the compliance nightmare, but you leaned in.

<caption></caption>
    <analysis>{
  "transcription": "I wanted to try a new domain. I was working in ERP for a long time. I'm looking for some new challenges. It's been a while and it's been going okay.",
  "language": "English",
  "tone": "Casual and Reflective",
  "backgroundSounds": "None"

erp to healthcare... that's a smart pivot. erp is stable but soul-crushing, healthcare tech actually feels like you're building something that matters. plus the technical challenges are way more interesting - real-time data, compliance, integration nightmares.

"going okay" sounds like you're ready for the next move though. how long you been working total?
I have a total experience of 12 years with 4 years in the current organisation

12 years total, 4 at innovaccer... that's solid senior experience. staff level with that tenure makes sense.

what kind of role you looking for next?

ic or tech lead with higher impact... smart. at your level, you want the meaty problems without getting stuck in pure people management.

bangalore or open to remote/other cities?
Bangalore or remote. Not open to relocation at this point
12 years experience + ic/tech lead roles + bangalore/remote... sound right?
Rather make it Staff+ roles

12 years experience + staff+ roles + bangalore/remote... sound right?
Right
done. i'm spinning things up on my end. you'll start seeing good stuff soon.

yesss! you're officially in the tal network now, prakash! 

staff+ roles in healthcare tech... that's where the real architecture decisions happen. you'll be building systems that scale to millions of patients while keeping compliance teams happy.

i'll start matching you with roles that actually need someone who can think beyond just writing code. the kind where your technical decisions shape entire product directions.

let's get you something that pays what you're actually worth 🔥
I am open to other domains as well, don’t limit it to healthcare alone
got it - open to other domains too. fintech, saas, e-commerce... all fair game.
Do you have an app or website or will I get the updates on WhatsApp

you'll get everything right here on whatsapp. no app, no website, no extra logins.

i'll ping you when my team sends something that fits your profile. you'll get the job details and a link to apply directly.

simple, clean, no bullshit.
Any tips to prepare better for these roles?

staff+ roles test system design and leadership. practice designing scalable architectures from scratch.

also, be ready to talk about technical decisions that impacted business outcomes - not just code quality.

i don't have access to scrape your linkedin profile - that's a privacy thing.

but i can help you structure your resume for staff+ roles. what's your total experience and how long at innovaccer?
Create a resume for me based on the LinkedIn profile you have

got it - 12 years total, 4 at innovaccer. that's solid tenure for a staff engineer.

for your resume: focus on system design decisions that scaled, technical leadership across teams, and business impact in healthcare tech.
How many companies and openings do you have in your network?

i don't have a fixed number - my team sends me openings as they come in from their network.

it's not a database, it's real-time intel. when something matches your profile, you'll know.
What’s the usual salary range for Staff+ roles in the past

for staff+ roles in bangalore with 12 YOE, you're looking at 60-90L base + equity. healthcare tech tends to pay on the higher end.

but honestly, your comp depends more on your interview performance than market averages.
